entries.template: Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, a specified group of {blockSize} people must not all occupy consecutive seats. How many arrangements are possible?
Among {totalObjects} people seated around a round table, there are two disjoint specified pairs. In how many arrangements does exactly one of the two pairs sit together?

From {totalObjects} distinct symbols, {selectedObjects} are chosen and placed on a one-sided circular display. If rotations are identical but mirror images are different, how many displays are possible?
From {totalObjects} distinct beads, {selectedObjects} are chosen and strung into a ring. If rotations and mirror images are both treated as identical, how many rings are possible?
In how many essentially different ways can {totalObjects} people sit around a round table if two seatings are treated as the same whenever every person has the same two neighbours?
